title: Agents
description: Who does what in the pipeline, with which models, and what it costs.
activeCount: {count, plural, one {# agent active} other {# agents active}}
banner: Agents propose, generate and check. They never approve, publish or archive.
bannerAdmin: As an Admin you can configure each agent from its page.

role.brand_analyst: Reads websites, screenshots, social exports and brand books; proposes findings and Brand Identity values.
role.strategist: Reads accepted findings and the published Brand Identity; writes diagnoses, plans, reports and content strategies.
role.copywriter: Writes outlines, slide texts, captions and hashtags, and edits slides on request.
role.art_director: Chooses layouts among the allowed ones and writes image prompts that respect the Brand Identity.
role.reviewer: Runs the Brand Guard checks on texts and renders. It does not approve.
role.creative_director: Sets the creative direction of a carousel: the concept, the thread across slides and what each slide must do, before the Copywriter writes.

reviewer.2: Issues to fix, slide by slide
reviewer.3: Notes for the person who approves

creative_director.3: Visual thread for the Art Director

capabilityHint.view: Reads the client data its tasks need.
capabilityHint.propose: Suggests changes that a person accepts or rejects.
capabilityHint.generate: Writes drafts that a person reviews.

detail.never: This agent cannot approve, publish or archive.

limits.1: Uses only approved or published Brand Identity elements.
limits.3: Never overrides binding rules: banned words, claims that are not allowed, logo use.

tasks.intro: The model each task of this agent uses. A task without its own choice follows the AI settings.
tasks.none: This agent does not call a language model: it runs checks inside Forgecy.
tasks.modelHint: Leave the model empty to use the service's default. A service without a key is skipped and the AI settings apply.
tasks.saved: Models saved. New runs use them.

instructions.intro: Instructions the agency adds to this agent's prompt, after its built-in rules. The built-in rules always win. Every run records the version it used.
instructions.nonePublished: No instructions published: the agent uses only its built-in prompt.
instructions.author: Author
instructions.textHint: Up to {max} characters. Write rules the agent should follow for every client, for example tone or words to avoid.
instructions.published_ok: Version {version} published. New runs use it.

runs.empty: This agent has not worked yet.

activation.title: Agent status
activation.activeBody: The agent is active: its functions are available for every client.
activation.inactiveBody: The agent is off: its functions stop for every client until you switch it on again.
activation.confirmBody: The functions that use it will not be available for any client until you switch it on again.

errors.disabled: {agent, select, brand_analyst {The Brand Analyst agent} strategist {The Strategist agent} copywriter {The Copywriter agent} art_director {The Art Director agent} reviewer {The Reviewer agent} other {This agent}} is switched off. An Admin can switch it on from the Agents page.
errors.invalidRoutes: The models could not be saved: check the services and tasks.
errors.tooLong: The instructions are too long: at most {max} characters.
errors.changelogRequired: Describe what changes in this version (3 to 500 characters).
errors.noDraft: There is no draft to publish: save one first.

run.title: {agent} run · {task}
run.neverAgent: A run never has an agent as its author.
run.inputsIntro: Forgecy records what was sent without the content itself: the size and a fingerprint (SHA-256) of each part.
run.noSecrets: Keys, passwords and access tokens are never recorded.
run.noOutput: No result was saved for this run.
run.noErrors: No errors · {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}

reason.no_ai: The client's AI policy does not allow AI.
reason.local_unavailable: The client allows only local models and none is configured.
reason.budget_exceeded: The AI budget is used up.
reason.other: Not allowed by the client's AI policy.

memory.title: Agents' memory
memory.counts: {candidate, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} · {approved, plural, one {# approved} other {# approved}}
memory.onlyApproved: Only approved memories reach the agents' prompts.
memory.nextAction: Next action: {count, plural, one {# candidate memory to decide} other {# candidate memories to decide}}
memory.sensitiveHint: Touches the Brand Identity: decided one by one.

empty.client: The agents have no memories for {client} yet. Proposals will come from the work on content, or add one.

bulk.title: Approve {count, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}?
bulk.body: The agents will use them from the next generations.
bulk.hint: Only non-sensitive candidates at medium or high confidence can be approved together.
bulk.done: {count, plural, one {# memory approved} other {# memories approved}}: the agents will use them from the next generations.

detail.title: Memory details
detail.none: Select a memory to see its details.
detail.usedInNone: No run has used it yet.

actions.approved: Memory approved: the agents will use it from the next generations.
actions.reasonHint: Required. The memory stays readable as rejected.
actions.editHint: Saving creates version {version}; earlier versions stay in the history.
actions.promoted: It is now a candidate memory.
actions.archiveBody: The agents will stop using it. It stays readable among the archived.
actions.brandHint: The published Brand Identity always wins: to change it, use a Brand Identity proposal.

addForm.title: Add memory
addForm.contentHint: A short sentence, up to {max} characters.

settings.title: Structured settings
settings.intro: Typed values, not sentences: the new carousel form and the Copywriter start from them.
settings.chooseClient: Choose a client to see its structured settings.
settings.notSet: Not set: the template or agency default applies.

errors.alreadyDecided: This memory was already decided in the meantime.
errors.alreadyDecidedBy: {name} already decided this memory in the meantime.
errors.noteRequired: At low confidence, approving needs a note (at least 3 characters).
errors.notBulk: Sensitive or low-confidence memories are approved one by one.

setting.slide_count: The number of slides must be between 3 and 20.
setting.format: Choose a format from the list.
setting.language: Choose a language from the list.
setting.default_cta: Write a CTA of up to 60 characters and choose its type.

stats.notEnough: At least {min} decided proposals are needed to compute the rate ({decided} so far).
stats.proposalsTitle: Proposals decided in the last 90 days
stats.failuresNone: No failed or blocked runs in the last 90 days.
stats.editsNone: No slide instruction was decided in the last 90 days.
stats.sources: Counted from Brand Identity proposals, audit observations, strategy proposals, product fields and memories.

preview.title: Try on an example
preview.intro: Runs one task with the draft above on an example you write. No client data is used; the run is logged and costed like any other.
preview.exampleHint: A brief or text like the ones this task receives, up to {max} characters. Do not paste client data.
preview.estimateUnknown: Uses {model}; the cost is logged after the try.
preview.noAi: The agency's default AI policy is no_ai: trying the prompt is not available.
preview.noTasks: This agent has no language-model task to try.

errors.task: Choose one of this agent's tasks.
errors.example: Write an example of 3 to {max} characters.
errors.noAi: The agency's default AI policy is no_ai: trying the prompt is not available.
